DZA.note: The arrêté sets login, e-signature and timestamp requirements for one procurement portal only; no national authentication service is stated.

facts.fact: The arrêté of 4 February 2026 cites law no. 18-07 of 10 June 2018, as amended, on the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data, among its legal bases.

DZA.note: Document is a procurement portal order and states nothing on rural internet access.
Document states no digital budget line, commitment or spending.

facts.fact: The arrêté of 4 February 2026 cites law no. 15-04 of 1 February 2015 setting general rules on electronic signature and certification, and requires the portal to sign documents electronically under it; this is a signatures law only.
The arrêté of 4 February 2026 cites executive decree no. 19-271 of 7 October 2019 on the national interoperability framework of information systems among its legal bases.
facts.system: référentiel national d'interopérabilité des systèmes d'information

DZA.note: The arrêté asks the procurement system to adopt interoperability standards but names no set of technical standards and says nothing of their content.
